prompt:
Create a polished design-review board with TWO fully rendered responsive landing-page compositions: desktop left, portrait mobile right. The supplied website is the edit target and visual reference for “Timber index”, Žemaitija Country Escapes. Preserve the distinctive deep forest-green surface, warm ivory serif accommodation names, three full-width ruled accommodation links and the broad-hipped-roof timber house photograph, with a light flat availability strip beneath. The typography and image belong to one accommodation index, never a card grid. High resolution landscape board, desktop at 1440×1100 equivalent and mobile at genuine 390×1350 portrait equivalent. No browser windows, devices or perspective.
Correct both views: wordmark only, remove decorative botanical logo. Empty Arrival/Departure controls with “Select date”; do not show 2025. Prominent near-top disclosure “Fictional portfolio demo · AI-generated illustrations · No real bookings”. Keep capacities Forest Cottage 2, Lakeside Cabin 2, Family Cottage 6. Each image reads “Illustrative property concept”. Replace invented property marketing paragraph with exactly “A fictional accommodation for up to 2 guests. Images are illustrative; facilities are not specified.” No other feature/location claims. No water in property photos. Retain “Three stays. Your own pace.” and clear Stays / Compare / Manage booking / Lietuvių / English / Deutsch navigation.
Mobile must be thoughtfully recomposed: compact header, disclosure, shortened photo crop, readable accommodation index rows, then stacked labelled Accommodation / Arrival / Departure / Guests fields and full-width “Check availability”. Keep the form findable without oversized type or giant photo pushing it far down. Begin one quiet property detail section below. Concept label outside pages: “B — Timber index”.

lineage.prompt: Create a high-fidelity English desktop website composition for “Žemaitija Country Escapes”, a fictional Lithuanian countryside accommodation booking demo inspired by the Plateliai area. Render the actual web page edge to edge, crisp legible UI, landscape 1440×1100 equivalent, no browser frame or surrounding objects. Real content: Forest Cottage, up to 2 guests; Lakeside Cabin, up to 2 guests; Family Cottage, up to 6 guests. Header includes the full brand, “Stays”, “Compare”, “Manage booking”, and “Lietuvių / English / Deutsch”. Show a real-looking availability form with persistent labels Accommodation, Arrival, Departure, Guests and primary action “Check availability”. No availability results or invented price. Prominent readable disclosure: “Fictional portfolio demo · AI-generated illustrations · No real bookings”. Label every property illustration “Illustrative property concept”. Do not invent amenities, reviews, locations, lake access or heritage status. Photorealistic illustrative scenes should reflect documented Samogitian timber rural buildings: broad hipped or half-hipped roofs, modest low timber walls, restrained detail, meadow and mixed spruce/birch woodland, temperate soft light. These are creative interpretations, not reconstructions or real-property photography. Avoid Mediterranean villas, Alpine chalets, Nordic glass cabins, amenities and generic accommodation cards. Direction B, “Timber index”: a committed dark forest-green page with warm ivory text, substantial sturdy serif accommodation names and clean sans controls. The opening is accommodation-first: full-width ruled selectable rows “Forest Cottage — Up to 2 guests”, “Lakeside Cabin — Up to 2 guests”, “Family Cottage — Up to 6 guests”, integrated with one large panoramic photograph of a broad-roofed dark timber dwelling in mixed woodland. Row selection and the image form one editorial index, no box grid. The heading “Three stays. Your own pace.” is modest relative to the accommodation names. An opaque ivory availability strip remains directly visible beneath the rows and photograph. Warm timber detail contributes to photographic material, never fake wood-textured UI. Explore links and a smaller second accommodation photo begin the next section. Intimate and tactile, distinct from a landscape-led travel magazine.
